raw_segments.text: At the appointed time I returned to Miss Havisham, S, and my hesitating ring at the gate brought
She locked it after admitting me, as she had done before, and again preceded me into the
dark passage where her candle stood.
She took no notice of me until she had the candle in her hand, when she looked over her
